gate_semantics.purpose: Freeze the complete application-owned atlas instance and its numerical execution choices before, but do not perform, the first full event-atlas run.

apertures.center_definition: phi_a^0, the fixed transported V2 finite-gate anchor label
apertures.entry_map_definition: The normalized (phase,action) disc is mapped by the exact P2d outgoing section and followed to the finite algebraic gate; the wider protected collar is not the flowbox disc.

apertures.center_definition: phi_h(mu), the selected P2c homoclinic source trace
apertures.entry_map_definition: The normalized (phase,action) disc is mapped by the exact P2d outgoing section and followed to the P2d incoming face; the wider protected collar is not the flowbox disc.

apertures.center_definition: 2*pi in the fixed lifted phase coordinate
apertures.entry_map_definition: The normalized (phase,action) disc is mapped by the exact P2d outgoing section and followed to -U=10; the wider protected collar is not the flowbox disc.

realization.definition: E_H,mu(x,t)=Phi_mu^(t tau_H,mu(x))(E_out_mu(phi_h(mu)+10^-8 x_h_1,2^-55 x_h_2)); tau_H,mu is the first hit of the P2d incoming face and the retained coordinate domain is x_h_1^2+x_h_2^2<=5/4

E_A,mu(x,t)=Phi_mu^(t tau_A,mu(x))(E_out_mu(phi_a^0+10^-7 x_a_1,2^-55 x_a_2)); tau_A,mu is the first hit of e=(-U)^(-1)=23/400 and the retained coordinate domain is x_a_1^2+x_a_2^2<=5/4; w_alg is a separate pulled-back label and is not x_a_2
E_P,mu(x,t)=Phi_mu^(t tau_P,mu(x))(E_out_mu(2*pi+10^-5 x_p_1,2^-55 x_p_2)); tau_P,mu is the first hit of -U=10 and the retained coordinate domain is x_p_1^2+x_p_2^2<=5/4
E_out_mu(psi_u,nu_u), the Kato-oriented exact P2d outgoing radial section restricted to the displayed proper lifted phase arc
E_in_mu(psi_r,nu_r), the Kato-oriented exact P2d incoming radial section with psi_r=0 on the transported stable trace
The positive-sign closed normalized source cell I_s x [0,1]
realization.map_definition: Pi_{+,infty,mu}:Z.PLUS->B.OUT in the fixed transported Kato lift

realization.definition: The negative-sign closed normalized source cell I_s x [0,1]
realization.map_definition: Pi_{-,infty,mu}:Z.MINUS->B.OUT in the fixed transported Kato lift

realization.definition: The positive-sign normalized cell restricted to the homoclinic aperture
The negative-sign normalized cell restricted to the homoclinic aperture

records.formula: t_h=1, identified by E_H,mu with the P2d incoming physical face
t_a=1, the transported transverse terminal with core representative e=23/400
t_p=1, the transported transverse terminal with core representative -U=10
nu_r=0
g_h=x_h,t-1; under E_H,mu this is the unique P2d incoming-face first-hit equation
g_alg=t_a-1; under E_A,mu its zero is the transverse transported terminal whose core representative is e=(-U)^(-1)=23/400
g_pole=t_p-1; under E_P,mu its zero is the transverse transported terminal whose core representative is -U=10

On C.A and B.OUT, w_alg is the transported core algebraic finite-gate label pulled back through E_A,mu and E_out,mu; on Z domains it is pulled back by Pi_sigma,infty. It is not identified with the signed action x_a_2.
((psi_u-phi_h(mu))/10^-8)^2+(nu_u/2^-55)^2-1, with composition by Pi_sigma,infty on Z.PLUS and Z.MINUS
((psi_u-phi_a^0)/10^-7)^2+(nu_u/2^-55)^2-1, with composition by Pi_sigma,infty on Z.PLUS and Z.MINUS; w_alg remains a separate label function
((psi_u-2*pi)/10^-5)^2+(nu_u/2^-55)^2-1, with composition by Pi_sigma,infty on Z.PLUS and Z.MINUS
(psi_r/(1/25))^2+(nu_r/2^-55)^2-1 on B.RET, pulled back by the C.H terminal product projection and by both restricted homoclinic maps
nu_r on B.RET, pulled back by the C.H terminal product projection and by both restricted homoclinic maps
tau_side_h-tau_terminal_h=3-4[((psi_u-phi_h(mu))/10^-8)^2+(nu_u/2^-55)^2] on its disjoint competing overlap and after Pi_sigma,infty pullback
tau_side_alg-tau_terminal_alg=3-4[((psi_u-phi_a^0)/10^-7)^2+(nu_u/2^-55)^2] on its disjoint competing overlap and after Pi_sigma,infty pullback
tau_side_pole-tau_terminal_pole=3-4[((psi_u-2*pi)/10^-5)^2+(nu_u/2^-55)^2] on its disjoint competing overlap and after Pi_sigma,infty pullback
tau_side_ret-tau_return=3-4[(psi_r/(1/25))^2+(nu_r/2^-55)^2] on B.RET and after both restricted homoclinic pullbacks

nonclaims: The carrier and pullback-domain formulas are prospectively frozen, but no physical carrier embedding has an interval certificate and no event-face, incidence, census, or m0 certificate exists.
READY_FOR_FIRST_FULL_RUN, if reached later, authorizes only a prospectively frozen computation and is not a mathematical PASS.
The three phase-gap subatoms cannot pass V2.EVENT_ATLAS without the complete transported traces and event census.
The frozen flagship prose proves existence of a suitable atlas but does not serialize the application-owned atlas required here.
The return-side occurrence is represented on return and pullback lists only through q_ret bound to the distinct occurrence u_r; it is not h_side_h and is not duplicated as a second side-hit function.
The bound terminal-flowbox scout is non-evidentiary design lineage only; no sampled orbit, affine proxy event, temporal-stability, Turing-selection, or canard conclusion is promoted.
